name: gap_momentum_5s
author: adapted from aggregated_from_x_indian_traders
thesis: Exploiting continuation of large gaps (>2%) driven by overnight news/institutional positioning. Inefficiency exists due to behavioral over-reaction by retail on open and information lag until first 1-min candle confirms direction. Hasn't been arbitraged away because strict 1-min confirmation + EOD flatten + costs make it unviable for high-frequency non-systematic traders in India.
mechanism: Large opening gaps that hold above the prior range indicate a genuine overnight revaluation. Participants who missed the gap chase the move, while short-sellers who are wrong-footed cover into the trend. The resulting buy pressure sustains the gap direction for the first 30-60 minutes until the new equilibrium is established.
weaknesses: Gap risk on open: adverse news after entry can cause immediate stop hits
Liquidity constraints: huge slippage in low-float gap stocks
VIX regime sensitivity: works only in low-VIX; fails in panic gaps
prior_art: Gap direction strategy (shared by @AlphaWizarDD on X)
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; apply to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index instead of FnO universe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
